en.name: Domain of the Dark Ruler
en.effect:
If you control no monsters, you can activate this card the turn it was Set. When your opponent activates a Spell/Trap Card and you have a Level 7 or higher DARK monster with 2500 DEF in your field or GY: Negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card, then if this card was activated during your turn, you can apply this effect.
● Neither player can activate Spell/Trap Cards for the rest of this turn.
You can only activate 1 "Domain of the Dark Ruler" per turn.
